//overrides: js-yaml is pinned forward past GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m (quadratic CPU on YAML
merge-key chains) and GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh (unbounded CPU use on empty merge
sources). minimatch is forced to ^11.0.1: that clears the brace-expansion ReDoS
through its own range (brace-expansion has no override of its own; the
lockfile carries the patched release) and GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (CPU use on
crafted glob parts), which has no fix below 11.0.1. All arrive through the
generator's own dependency chain, which pins versions npm audit fix
cannot reach, so an override is the only way to move them without
abandoning the generator. Drop these once openapi-typescript ships a
@redocly/openapi-core that depends on the patched versions itself.
